aggregation.answerUnit: One reader answer scored by the other model only; self-judging is forbidden.
aggregation.caseArm: Arithmetic mean of the MiniMax-reader/DeepSeek-judge score and the DeepSeek-reader/MiniMax-judge score.
aggregation.population: Arithmetic mean of case-arm scores over the frozen 200-case census.
aggregation.fama: For each judged answer, MPA minus lambda times one minus FAA, clipped at zero; lambda is forgetting criteria divided by all criteria. The two crossed-reader FAMA scores are then averaged per case-arm before population aggregation.

decisionRule: A challenger is promoted only if every predeclared full-population quality, uncertainty, cost and integrity gate passes. Subgroups explain mechanisms but cannot override a failed primary gate.

reuse.rule: Reuse is allowed only for byte-identical reader message arrays within the same frozen case.

claimBoundary: This panel tests robustness and causal policy factors on previously unconsumed Memora questions. It is not a pristine dataset holdout, a human evaluation, or evidence about real programming-agent traffic.
